spec: dispatch://LEGION-13/spec (human-approved; requirements record — not restated here)
summary: Thread a required `env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv` through `loadStartConfig`, `cmdCheckConfig`, `cmdStart`, and `cmdRestart` in packages/daemon/src/cli/index.ts; `process.env` is written only in the citty `startCommand.run` and `restartCommand.run` handlers. The two `legion start --check-config` tests pass `{ PATH, HOME }`; one new test pins that `cmdCheckConfig` reads the injected env (DISPATCH_URL without DISPATCH_TOKEN rejects; with DISPATCH_TOKEN accepts). `resolveDaemonConfig` untouched. docs/solutions/legion/worker-pane-shell-gotchas.md § 2 (the `env -u` workaround) is removed in the same PR.

signatures.loadStartConfig: (project: string | undefined, configPath: string | undefined, env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv, options: LoadConfigFileOptions = {}): DaemonConfig — env before the defaulted options; no default for env
signatures.cmdStart: (project, configPath, env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): Promise<void> — also uses env for resolveLegionPaths so the function has one environment
signatures.cmdRestart: (project: string, configPath, env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): Promise<void> — forwards env to cmdStart; cmdStop unchanged

a GhCommandDeps-style deps object for a single injected field (file already uses bare positional env: daemonUrl(env), resolveControllerSecret(env))
